summary: Linkify trims trailing punctuation and an unmatched ')' in a single pass, so punctuation exposed by the ')' trim stays inside the autolink.

provenance.note: Evaluator-only. base_sha is the parent of the upstream fix; the fix is never reachable from the sealed clone.
provenance.reference_patch: Source fix only: the extension/linkify.go hunk of e4435f3..13ff14c, verbatim. The upstream hunk adding cases to extension/_test/linkify.txt is omitted: that file mixes CRLF and LF line endings upstream, so it cannot be applied after the verifier normalises patches to LF, and the hidden tests do not depend on it.
provenance.hidden_tests_note: Hidden tests use their own inputs (example.net/example.org URLs), not the upstream test-data cases; expected HTML follows the cmark-gfm autolink trimming rules and was confirmed against the upstream fix.
provenance.size_note: about 15k non-test Go lines at base (large); the fix is confined to one function but requires understanding the interaction of three trimming rules

reference.note: Evaluator-only. The verifier renders the reference patch from upstream: git diff --binary -M base_sha commit -- paths, per step.
